chapter: Paris, Lester Young, drugs, Mississippi and later sessions
title: How Art Tatum influenced his guitar playing
summary: Sitting at the bend of the piano nightly broadened Collins's harmonic thinking, which showed after he left.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: You said that you were overwhelmed by Art's piano playing when you first started working with him. Do you feel that he influenced your playing at all, I mean the way you play guitar?

Well, I mean chordal -- you know, chordally, harmonically. You just couldn't sit there and not be influenced by him. Of course as I told you at first I -- it was just so much I didn't know -- I had no direction with it, you know, at first, because it was coming at me too fast. I sat in the bend of that piano every night, and boy, I'm telling you. But after -- as I told you before, after I left him then really I could see that things had just seeped in and I was thinking in much -- my music had broadened, my music had broadened, you know. And it was just something you just couldn't pay for. Sure it influenced me.
